title: Gapingvoid Culture Design Group — 'Culture Bank: Insufficient Funds' opens by anchoring on Ries's coherence
summary: Gapingvoid — the culture design studio with 70k Twitter followers — publishes a piece riffing on Incorruptible's coherence concept, using the Enron in-marble-values example to open its own culture-bank framework.
blockquote:
Every culture has a bank account, @ericries reminds in his new book.

Nobody bankrupts a culture all at once. Every decision is either a deposit or a withdrawal.

So, are you building equity or spending it?
